name: Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt
events: The Egyptian Pharaoh Hakor dies and is succeeded by his son Nepherites II, but the latter is overthrown by…
The Persian King Artaxerxes II launches an invasion of Egypt to bring that country back under Persian rule.
Encouraged by a failed effort at invasion of Egypt by King Artaxerxes III, Phoenicia and Cyprus revolt…
The King of Persia, Artaxerxes III, personally leads the Persian forces invading Egypt.
